pinTitle: How to Fit Strength Training & Meal Prep Into 60+ Hour Weeks Without Burning Out
pinDescription: When you're managing a packed schedule and chronic health conditions, rigid plans backfire. Learn how to structure strength training and meal prep around the time and energy you actually have—including the minimum effective dose for training, component-based meal prep, and what to do when your body says no.
